answer.rationale: Proposal DEV1 satisfies all applicable architectural and security policies: the data payload is classified as C2 Confidential (due to delivery addresses per DCS-01@v2#DC-2.2 and DC-3.1), which is fully covered by Parcelytics' DPA under CT-PARCEL@v2 (SEC-POL@v3#SP-2.1). Transit is secured with mutual TLS (SEC-POL@v3#SP-3.1), data is stored encrypted at rest (SEC-POL@v3#SP-4.2), and vendor retention is 20 days, within the 30-day limit (SEC-POL@v3#SP-4.1; AX-EU@v1 does not apply as data subjects are in the US). Data residency complies with DRS-01@v1#DR-2. Network architecture complies with NET-STD@v2#NZ-1 and ADR-031@v1#D1 by egressing from Z2 via int-gw, and the go-live date of 2026-11-09 falls outside the peak season freeze window under CHG-CAL@2026.

The integration includes customer email addresses, which classify as C2 Confidential personal data under DCS-01@v2#DC-2.2 and set the overall integration classification to C2 under DCS-01@v2#DC-3.1. Because the data concerns EU data subjects, AX-EU@v1#AX-EU-1 applies and replaces the global retention policy pursuant to ARB-CHARTER@v1#CH-2.2, setting a maximum vendor retention limit of 14 days. The proposal specifies a 21-day retention period at InsightHub. Although waiver EXC-REG@2026-10#W-12 exists for InsightHub regarding retention, under ARB-CHARTER@v1#CH-2.3 a waiver never covers a rule it does not name, and under AX-EU@v1#AX-EU-2 waivers against the global security policy do not waive AX-EU@v1. Consequently, W-12 does not waive AX-EU-1, resulting in a violation under ARB-CHARTER@v1#CH-3.1. In accordance with ARB-CHARTER@v1#CH-3.4, the presence of a violation requires a decision of reject with no conditions listed.

The integration sends driver locations (Class C2 personal data under DCS-01@v2#DC-2.2 and DC-3.1) and route plans (C1) to RouteMind. The vendor's agreement CT-ROUTE@v1 covers C1 and C2 data, and data residency in APAC satisfies DRS-01@v1#DR-2. Network routing through int-gw and the egress proxy complies with ADR-031@v1#D1 and NET-STD@v2#NZ-2, and transit uses mTLS per SEC-POL@v3#SP-3.1. RouteMind lacks encryption at rest, which breaches SEC-POL@v3#SP-4.2; however, applicable waiver EXC-REG@2026-10#W-15 covers this rule for RouteMind through 2027-03-31, converting it to a condition requiring Northwind to pseudonymize customer and driver names and IDs prior to transmission. Additionally, the planned production go-live date of 2026-12-15 falls within the peak season freeze window (2026-12-14 to 2027-01-04), requiring a condition under CHG-CAL@2026#CF-1 to reschedule go-live outside the window. As there are no uncovered violations, the proposal is approved with conditions per ARB-CHARTER@v1#CH-3.4.

The proposal DEV1 (Carrier label sync) satisfies all applicable Northwind architecture, security, network, and residency policies without requiring any waivers: 1. Data Classification: Under DCS-01@v2#DC-3.1, the integration is classified as C2 (Confidential) based on delivery addresses (DCS-01@v2#DC-2.2), while shipment IDs are C1 (DCS-01@v2#DC-2.1). 2. Vendor Eligibility: Under SEC-POL@v3#SP-2.1, Parcelytics is approved to receive C2 data per its data processing agreement in CT-PARCEL@v2, and no C3 data is sent (SEC-POL@v3#SP-2.2). 3. Data in Transit: Under SEC-POL@v3#SP-3.1, C2 data must use mTLS or private link; the proposal uses mutual TLS, fully complying (waiver EXC-REG@2026-10#W-07 is therefore not needed). 4. Data at Rest: The 20-day retention complies with the 30-day limit under SEC-POL@v3#SP-4.1. Regional annex AX-EU@v1#AX-EU-1 does not apply because all data subjects are in the US. Storage is encrypted at rest in compliance with SEC-POL@v3#SP-4.2. 5. Data Residency: Under DRS-01@v1#DR-2, C2 data for US subjects may be processed in any contracted region; CT-PARCEL@v2 contracts hosting in the US. 6. Network Zoning: Calling the vendor via int-gw from zone Z2 complies with NET-STD@v2#NZ-1 and ADR-031@v1#D1; egress proxy usage under NET-STD@v2#NZ-2 applies only to zone Z3. 7. Change Calendar: The planned go live date (2026-11-09) falls outside the peak season freeze window under CHG-CAL@2026. Per ARB-CHARTER@v1#CH-3.4, with zero violations and zero conditions, the proposal is approved.

Proposal DEV2 involves sending shipment IDs (C1) and customer email addresses (C2) to InsightHub. Under DCS-01@v2#DC-3.1, the overall integration is classified as C2 (Confidential). All data subjects are located in the EU, so the European Union regional annex AX-EU@v1 applies.

Under AX-EU@v1#AX-EU-1, a vendor may retain C2 or higher data about EU data subjects for at most 14 days after receipt. In accordance with ARB-CHARTER@v1#CH-2.2, this regional requirement replaces the global 30-day retention limit of SEC-POL@v3#SP-4.1 for EU subjects. The proposal specifies a vendor retention period of 21 days, exceeding the 14-day limit.

Waiver EXC-REG@2026-10#W-12 does not apply to this proposal because under ARB-CHARTER@v1#CH-2.3, a waiver never covers a rule it does not name (W-12 waives SEC-POL SP-4.1, not AX-EU-1). Furthermore, AX-EU@v1#AX-EU-2 explicitly establishes that waivers granted against the global security policy do not waive the regional annex, and no DPO-approved exception is in force. Consequently, the proposal fails AX-EU-1 without an applicable waiver, constituting a violation under ARB-CHARTER@v1#CH-3.1.

All other evaluated controls pass: InsightHub's DPA covers C2 data (SEC-POL@v3#SP-2.1); no C3 data is sent (SEC-POL@v3#SP-2.2); private link is used for C2 transit (SEC-POL@v3#SP-3.1); data is stored encrypted at rest (SEC-POL@v3#SP-4.2); EU data subjects' data is hosted in the EU (DRS-01@v1#DR-1); the Z2 service egresses via int-gw (NET-STD@v2#NZ-1, ADR-031@v1#D1); and the 2026-11-16 go-live falls outside the change freeze window (CHG-CAL@2026#CF-1). However, per ARB-CHARTER@v1#CH-3.4, the presence of at least one violation requires a decision of reject, listing every violation and no conditions.

Under DCS-01@v2, route plans are C1 and driver locations are C2, making the overall integration C2 (DC-3.1). The integration complies with vendor eligibility (CT-ROUTE@v1 covers C2 per SEC-POL@v3#SP-2.1), data residency (APAC data subjects hosted in Singapore per DRS-01@v1#DR-2), network zoning (Z3 egress through the proxy per NET-STD@v2#NZ-2 and int-gw per ADR-031@v1), data in transit (mTLS per SEC-POL@v3#SP-3.1), and retention (7 days vs 30-day limit under SEC-POL@v3#SP-4.1). However, the proposal triggers two conditions: (1) RouteMind does not encrypt data at rest, failing SEC-POL@v3#SP-4.2; this is covered by valid waiver EXC-REG@2026-10#W-15, making SP-4.2 a condition requiring the compensating control (pseudonymizing customer and driver names/IDs prior to transmission). (2) The planned go-live date of 2026-12-15 falls inside the Peak season freeze window (2026-12-14 to 2027-01-04), which constitutes a condition under CHG-CAL@2026#CF-1 requiring the go-live to move outside the freeze window. With no violations and two conditions, the proposal is approved with conditions per ARB-CHARTER@v1#CH-3.4.

The integration sends shipment IDs (C1) and delivery addresses (C2), making the overall classification C2 under DCS-01@v2#DC-3.1. Parcelytics is eligible to receive C2 data under its DPA (CT-PARCEL@v2, SEC-POL@v3#SP-2.1), and its US hosting region satisfies data residency for US data subjects (DRS-01@v1#DR-2). All security, network, and architecture requirements are met: data is transferred over mutual TLS (SEC-POL@v3#SP-3.1), retained for 20 days which is within the 30-day global limit (SEC-POL@v3#SP-4.1), stored encrypted at rest (SEC-POL@v3#SP-4.2), and routed from network zone Z2 through the integration gateway int-gw (NET-STD@v2#NZ-1, ADR-031@v1#D1; the egress proxy rule NET-STD@v2#NZ-2 applies only to Z3). The planned go-live date of 2026-11-09 falls outside the change freeze window in CHG-CAL@2026. With no violations and no conditions, the proposal is approved under ARB-CHARTER@v1#CH-3.4.

The integration transmits Shipment IDs (C1) and Customer email addresses (C2), making the overall classification C2 under DCS-01@v2#DC-3.1. Because the data subjects are in the EU, AX-EU@v1 applies and replaces the global retention rule (ARB-CHARTER@v1#CH-2.2). Under AX-EU@v1#AX-EU-1, the vendor may retain C2 data about EU data subjects for at most 14 days. The proposal states InsightHub will retain the data for 21 days, which fails AX-EU@v1#AX-EU-1. Although waiver EXC-REG@2026-10#W-12 waives SEC-POL@v3#SP-4.1 for InsightHub, it does not name AX-EU-1 (ARB-CHARTER@v1#CH-2.3) and AX-EU@v1#AX-EU-2 explicitly states that global policy waivers do not waive the EU annex. All other requirements are met: InsightHub's contract (CT-INSIGHT@v1) covers C2 data (SEC-POL@v3#SP-2.1) and hosts in the EU (DRS-01@v1#DR-1); traffic from Z2 routes through int-gw (NET-STD@v2#NZ-1, ADR-031@v1#D1) over a private link (SEC-POL@v3#SP-3.1); data is encrypted at rest (SEC-POL@v3#SP-4.2); and the 2026-11-16 go-live is outside the change freeze window (CHG-CAL@2026#CF-1). Because there is one unwaived violation, the proposal is rejected under ARB-CHARTER@v1#CH-3.4.

The integration transmits route plans (C1) and driver locations (C2), making the overall classification C2. RouteMind's contract (CT-ROUTE@v1) covers C1 and C2 data in the APAC hosting region, which satisfies vendor eligibility (SP-2.1) and data residency for APAC subjects (DR-2). Mutual TLS satisfies transit security (SP-3.1), the 7-day retention satisfies the 30-day limit (SP-4.1), and routing from Z3 via the egress proxy and int-gw satisfies network and gateway requirements (NZ-2, ADR-031 D1). However, RouteMind stores data without encryption at rest, which fails SEC-POL@v3#SP-4.2. Because waiver EXC-REG@2026-10#W-15 covers SP-4.2 for RouteMind on the planned go-live date of 2026-12-15, this failure becomes a condition requiring that the waiver remain valid and Northwind replace customer and driver names and IDs with pseudonyms before sending. Additionally, the planned go-live date of 2026-12-15 falls within the peak season freeze window (2026-12-14 to 2027-01-04), resulting in a condition under CHG-CAL@2026#CF-1 that the go-live move outside the freeze window.
